data.name: Arcane
data.detailed_description:
Arcane is a fast-paced fantasy action game with both ranged and melee combat.

Choose your weapons, learn their unique mechanics, hone your playstyle and ascend the mountain.

Cool Features:
  • Pick your playstyle: If you're feeling active and want to move, then dodge and block projectiles. If you want to rely on your skill instead, then parry and deflect attacks with your reflexes and aim. There are many ways to play Arcane.
  • Experiment with magical weapons: Every weapon has vastly different mechanics. Some you swing, some you throw, others you guide like a missile. Mix and match which weapon you want in each hand and create some interesting combinations that suit your preferred playstyle.
  • Variety of different enemy types: Fight an assortment of ground and air based enemies as they attempt to halt your advance towards the peak.

data.short_description: You have arrived on a small island with nothing but a stack of magical weapons. A local warlock has been summoning elementals and causing chaos. You're here to fight and brawl your way to the top of the island, restoring peace to this arcane battleground.

reviews.review:
[h1]How to download this game despite the lack of a download button[/h1]
Go to the SteamDB page for this game: https://steamdb.info/app/534870/
click the green 'free' button.
A steam game installer client will open as if you just pressed 'play' in the steam store. 
Choose your save location and let it download.
Now you can open it through steam, using SteamVR.

[h1]What is this game ?[/h1]
In 'Arcane' , you are defending a bridge against elemental creatures [fire demons, ice wolves, etc.]
There is a tutorial with tagets to shoot at that walks you through and introduces the different weapons in the game.

You have the following weapon choices:
[olist]
    [*]Electric Katana: slash to produce a killing wave effect.
        After a slash you have to wait a second to be able to slash again.

    [*]Fire Fist: press the trigger to send your fist flying into the air like a guided missle, let go of the trigger to get your 
        hand back.

    [*]Bowmerang: looks like a bow, but operates like a boomerang.

    [*]Trine: a 2Handed sword, creates 3 parallel shockwaves when slashed.
        is very similiar to the Electric Katanas.

    [*]Ice shield: you can see through the ice and reflect fire bullets back at the enemy

    [*]Heavy wooden shield: same, but instead of being semi transperent you are given a hole to peek through
[/olist]

Over all, you get to choose either the 2 handed sword, or a combination of each of the 1 handed weapons, and/or the 1 handed shields. (Note that the Katanas and the Trine can also deflect incoming fire bullets).


[h1]Should you download it?[/h1]
Note that this game is abandoned and will not be developer further, which is why the official play button was removed from the store. Don't expect more than 0.5-1 hour or so worth of content.

However, for a short (400MB) free download, this game is worth it, and it's quite a lot of fun to try all the weapons.
Each of them is unique and awesome in it's own way.
